summary: News Corporation filed an 8-K (Items 8.01/9.01) on November 5, 2026, disclosing daily ASX-transparency notices tied to its existing stock repurchase program, under which it may acquire up to $1 billion in aggregate of Class A (NWSA) and Class B (NWS) common stock from time to time. The filing covers no new authorization or price terms and names no advisor; exhibits 99.1/99.2 are the ASX disclosures. Mechanics are open-market buybacks subject to market conditions and securities laws, flagged with standard forward-looking-statement caveats. Watch pace of executions versus the $1 billion authorization and any signal on buyback cadence.
